stem:
The v–t graph of a body of mass 5 kg moving with the help of a force is shown. Then the force involved is

(The figure is a velocity–time graph. Velocity v is on the vertical axis in m s⁻¹ and time t is on the horizontal axis in seconds. The graph is a straight line through the origin rising uniformly, passing 5 m s⁻¹ at 2 s and reaching 10 m s⁻¹ at 4 s — a constant acceleration.)

The given image correlates with which law of motion?

(The figure shows two cricketers catching a ball. The left fielder holds his hands up to receive the ball, while the right fielder draws his hands downward and backward as the ball arrives, increasing the time of contact to cushion the catch.)

In the given image, the goalkeeper held his palm in the path of the moving ball to show that

(The figure shows a goalkeeper in front of a goal net holding his hands in the path of an oncoming football, stopping the ball.)

options.label: A
options.text: A force can change the speed of a moving body

options.label: B
options.text: A force can move a stationary body

options.label: C
options.text: A force can stop a moving body

options.label: D
options.text: A force can change the shape of the object
